desc: Read the problem and understand the game rules.
Test simple parity rules (sum, sum-N) and find they fail for some cases.
Analyze N=1 and N=2 cases: N=1 always Fennec wins; N=2 always Snuke wins.
Test small N=3 cases to see patterns: [1,1,1] Fennec, [1,1,2] Snuke, [1,1,3] Fennec, [1,2,2] Fennec, [1,2,3] Fennec.
Observe that for N=2, second player always wins regardless of A_i.
Run the brute-force program to generate the full table for N up to 3, A_i up to 3, and examine the output.
Formulate a hypothesis for the winning condition based on the generated table.
Test the hypothesis against all known cases (samples and small N=3).
Implement the final solution in Python.
